_comment: The 14 official grading shapes, from Appendix: Test Shapes.
The appendix column 'QKV Dim' is d_model here, and ffn_dim equals it in
every shape -- so there is no 4x FFN expansion anywhere in the set, and
attention plus per-layer overhead dominates rather than the FFN.
All 14 are causal. Layers is 4 everywhere except shape 14, which is 2.
Shape 1 is the base; 2-6 vary batch, 7-8 vary d_model, 9-11 vary heads,
12-13 vary seq_len, and 14 is its own thing.
head_dim = d_model / heads decides which attention kernel can run:
wmma and scalar cover {8,16,32,64,128}, the tile kernels {8,16,32,64}.
This file is re-read on every request, so edits appear on the next page
load with no restart. Keys: name, batch_size, seq_len, d_model, heads,
ffn_dim, layers, causal, note. Anything else is ignored.

presets.name: 1 - base
presets.note: head_dim 32. The reference point the other twelve vary one axis from.

presets.name: 2 - batch 1
presets.note: head_dim 32. Smallest work per launch in the set, so kernel launch overhead dominates and CUDA graph capture pays most here.

presets.name: 5 - batch 128
presets.note: head_dim 32. Enough blocks to fill the card.

presets.name: 6 - batch 10000
presets.note: head_dim 32. The largest runnable shape: ~3 GiB, most of it the baseline's [B,H,S,S] scores. Slow, but it fits.

presets.name: 7 - d_model 32
presets.note: head_dim 8, the narrowest in the set.

presets.name: 8 - d_model 1024
presets.note: head_dim 256 -- outside every custom kernel (wmma/scalar stop at 128, tile at 64), so attention falls back to SDPA. Forcing any --attn-impl here will be refused.

presets.name: 9 - 1 head
presets.note: head_dim 128 -- wmma and scalar cover it, the tile kernels do not.

presets.name: 10 - 2 heads
presets.note: head_dim 64, the widest the tile kernels reach.

presets.name: 12 - seq 32
presets.note: head_dim 32. Shortest sequence in the set; the regime split-KV targets.

presets.name: 13 - seq 1024
presets.note: head_dim 32. Longest runnable sequence here; the baseline's scores are 1 GiB, and attention starts to dominate.

presets.name: 14 - seq 100000
presets.note: head_dim 64, 2 layers. Runs: the harness streams the batch (32 slices of 1 row) because the full 12.2 GiB input does not fit, and skips the baseline, whose scores are 596 GiB even one row at a time. So this reports real latencies with no speedup and no accuracy verdict -- there is no reference to compare against.
